page.overview:
Who is Czigo?

For adaption equivalents, see Czigo/1984 film and Czigo/2021 film

was a Soldier and Assassin in service of House Harkonnen who, along with his comrade Kinet, was assigned by Mentat Piter de Vries to eliminate Paul Atreides and Lady Jessica Atreides in the deserts outside the Shield Wall.

Both Harkonnen Soldiers were killed by Paul and Lady Jessica when they escaped by using the Voice.
